We say goodbye to this handsome gentleman today.

Georgia's governor signs a comically transparent law.

It makes local elections in 5 big blue counties nonpartisan, to give GOP candidates a chance to win without a party label in places like Atlanta.

And it doesn't change anything in the rest of the state, for red counties to know who's GOP.

In a response to the long-debunked "retail theft epidemic," the House voted 348 to 60 for a bill that would exacerbate mass incarceration by sweeping more low-level crime into the federal system and exacerbate the criminalization of poverty. 

TY to the 59 Democrats who voted NO (see below).

This would constitute one of the most brazen, most appalling acts of corruption in U.S. history.

I know we’re numb to all of this but this is a seven-alarm fire.

He chose to write about an electric vehicle tax credit. He thought it was good for the environment.

Virginia responded by attacking him and his teacher for being propagandized.

These people have power over your life.

—MO: State SC stalled veto referendum, allows GOP to end Dem seat
